{{Quote|This weapon is your life!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
This blue-bladed '''lightsaber''' was Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber—the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] of which the thirteen-year-old [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] assembled in an [[Hibernation trance/Legends|entranced]] state (from pieces he'd built earlier) during his [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate's]] [[Gathering/Legends|Gathering]] [[Jedi Trials/Legends#Trial of the Spirit|trial]] in the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]—was the first lightsaber created by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], after losing his initial weapon on Ilum. It was used by Skywalker for seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before its destruction just prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Specifications==
{{Quote|Here is the hilt you worked on and the other components. After you find the crystals, you will fashion the lightsaber to your own hand.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Jedi Quest 1">[[Jedi Quest 1|''Jedi Quest'' 1]]</ref>}}
Rather than imitate [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|his master's]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] design, as was customary, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] instead created a solid, heavy-duty [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] that favored maximum strength.<ref name="AOTCvd">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The [[Dual-phase lightsaber|dual-phase weapon]] featured a solid casing, ridged handgrip, forward mounted adjustment knobs and a beveled emitter shroud as well as a "throttle-style" activator. Along with the blue color crystal, it also utilized a high output [[Diatium/Legends|diatium]] [[Diatium power cell/Legends|power cell]] and a dual-phase [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|focusing crystal]].<ref name="DL:TRODV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'': [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|Darth Vader's lightsaber]] is stated in the novel to be a replica of this weapon, save for a few details specified by the novel.''</ref> The basic design of this weapon was also incorporated into his [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|second lightsaber]] albeit with a modified shroud and mid-section.<ref name="AOTC" />

==History==
===Construction===
{{Quote|What's this? You made this?''"<br />"''I&hellip; I must have. You appeared to me. You told me to go into a trance state. I felt the Force very strongly.''"<br />"''This is a good sign, Padawan. When you allow your instincts to take over, they will not fail you. The Force is always with you.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], after the construction of his lightsaber|<ref name="Jedi Quest 1" /> Ultimately defeating the ghosts, Skywalker awoke from his trance to find his lightsaber fully constructed.<ref name="Path to Truth" /> The weapon, he immediately found, was "a perfect fit"<ref name="Path to Truth" /> and "perfectly balanced to his hand."<ref name="The Way of the Apprentice">''[[Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Anakins_lightsaber.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Hibernation trance/Legends|Force-entranced]], fabricating his lightsaber.]]
In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] constructed the pieces of his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] prior to arriving on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], where he chose three [[Ilum crystal/Legends|crystals]] that "seemed to speak to him" from the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]]. After banishing from his mind the horrifying specter of an eerily familiar yet indeterminate [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] pursuing his mother [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi]], but also after being startled by a second specter in the almost equally terrifying image of the emergent [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], whom he immediately attacked, he dropped the crystals.<ref name="Path to Truth" /><ref name="Jedi Quest 1" />

===First blood===
{{Quote|You can deactivate your weapon now, Padawan.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], after [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] killed [[Krayn]] with his lightsaber|<ref name="Jedi Quest 1" />}}
[[File:KraynShiaked.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] using his lightsaber to [[Shiak|impale]] [[Krayn]].]]
One of the earliest uses of this lightsaber was when Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were intercepted by the slaver [[Krayn]], whom Skywalker remembered from his childhood on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The weapon's first "kill" was actually of a non-living entity—a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in [[Krayn's pirate starship|the pirate ship's]] weapons-control tech center that Skywalker decapitated and impaled; the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] "felt a surge of satisfaction from the power of his new lightsaber. He wasn't in training mode anymore."<ref name="Path to Truth" /> Kenobi managed to escape the slaver's ship, while Skywalker and the undercover Jedi [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] went on to start a rebellion among Krayn's [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. In the end, Skywalker faced the slaver in combat, besting him. Ignoring his master's command to spare Krayn, in favor of what Skywalker felt were [[Precognition/Legends|promptings]] delivered by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] itself, Skywalker [[Shiak|impaled]] the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]].<ref name="Path to Truth" /><ref name="Jedi vs. Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

===Vision===
[[File:Duel_in_the_Jedi_Council_Chamber.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Anakin battling a dark-side entity]]
Sometime after the construction of his lightsaber, Anakin [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] darkness and later was [[Telekinesis/Legends|choked]] by something he could not see during a lesson in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Tiplee/Legends|Tiplee]] and [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Sinube]] brush off his concerns so that night, he investigates and goes to the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|Jedi Council Chamber]], where he meets a [[Unidentified dark side entity|dark-side entity]] who tells him that he will turn to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Anakin igniting his lightsaber to battle the entity until it uses the Force to destroy his lightsaber and blasts him with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Despite the loss of his saber, Anakin manages to defeat the entity and Tiplee and Obi-Wan found him unconscious where it was revealed to be a vision.<ref name="TOP">{{SWComicCite|7.9|Temple of Phantoms}}</ref>

===Early missions===
The young Jedi's new weapon saw use on [[Radnor/Legends|Radnor]], where, in [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]], Skywalker accompanied Kenobi and various other [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]] to [[Mission to Radnor|aid in the evacuation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] following a dangerous toxic leak. While traveling to the world's [[Isolation Sector]] from its [[Clear Sector]], they encountered a [[Radnoran]] family being terrorized by a number of [[Avoni]] raiders. Skywalker disobeyed orders and aided the Knights in fighting off the raiders rather than protecting the family, as he and his fellow students had been directed to do. Skywalker also came into conflict with [[Ferus Olin]], Siri Tachi's Padawan. Though the mission was technically a success, with the leaked toxins neutralized and the raiders stopped, Skywalker felt that the planet was now even worse off than when they found it.<ref name="The Way of the Apprentice" />

===Separatist Crisis===
====Mission to Ansion====
[[File:Anakin-_The_Moment_of_Truth.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] wielding the lightsaber during his early years as [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Padawan/Legends|student]].]]
[[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] was to a casual observer an insignificant world, but upon closer inspection, it was connected to over forty other neighboring [[Star system/Legends|systems]] by a complex web of treaties and alliances. If Ansion seceded from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], it would drag along every world that it maintained an alliance with. Kenobi and Skywalker were [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|dispatched]] to the world to prevent that from happening. Arriving on Ansion two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] early, Kenobi and Skywalker met with [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] just in time to save them from a veritable army of [[Mercenary/Legends|contract killers]]. Leaping over a retaining wall into the dead-end alley the women were cornered in, Skywalker and Kenobi made short work of the [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. Later, the four met with the [[Politics/Legends|political]] leaders of Ansion. While the meeting with the politicians itself went well, they still had the nomadic [[Alwari]] to placate.<ref name="TAS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>

While the Jedi spent their spare time perusing the shops and vendors of the Ansion [[Cuipernam|capital]], Offee was kidnapped by two insane Alwari exiles hired by the local [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord, [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg the Hutt]], who was on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] payroll. However, Offee managed to convince the two exiles to aid them after healing the neurological deformities that had caused their insanity. Rejoining the other Jedi, the exiles, [[Bulgan]] and [[Kyakhta]], took on the role of guides, leading them through the Ansion wilderness as they left the city to meet with the Alwari. Their travel through the plains almost ended in disaster, however, when they were beset by a school of [[Gairk]]s while crossing the [[Torosogt River]]. Offee was yanked off her [[Suubatar]] steed by the creatures and dragged downriver to be eaten later. Skywalker swam after her, but only succeeded in getting himself caught by a quartet of Gairks. His attempts at resisting their suction unsuccessful, Skywalker instead went with the flow, allowing them to pull him within lightsaber range.<ref name="TAS" />

After this, they continued their journey across the plains, making contact with the [[Yiwa]] clan. Ingratiating themselves with the nomads, they were provided with directions to find the overclan, [[Borokii]]. However, along the way, they were captured by the merchant clan [[Qulun]], which was being paid by Soergg the Hutt, after being drugged while dining with the clan leader. However, they were rescued by [[Tooqui]], a [[Gwurran]]. While reclaiming their mounts from the Qulun guards, Skywalker began toying with one of them. However, when Kenobi began noticing, Skywalker quickly killed the guard with a cut to the neck, claiming that the fighter was faster than he thought. Later, as they rode north again, they were attacked by a pack of [[Shanh]]s. Ambushed by one of the creatures while serving as camp lookout, Skywalker was quickly disarmed. Forced to rely on the Force, he managed to [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] deflect the creatures killing leap, but was caught unawares by the Shanh's mate. Managing to blast it aside with a Force push, Skywalker reclaimed his lightsaber and killed the creature as it leapt at him again. He turned to find that the first Shanh had been killed by Unduli.<ref name="TAS" />

The following day, they finally made contact with the Borokii. While quickly welcomed by the secure clan, they were forced to present an offering of white wool sheared from an [[Albino/Legends|albino]] [[Surepp]]. The tuft of fur was retrieved by Unduli. While the meeting itself went well, the Jedi were left with the condition that allegiance would only be granted if the Jedi helped settle the clan warfare between the Borokii and the rival [[Januul]]. Negotiations turned sour, and the Jedi's attempts to intervene left them ostracized from both groups. A massive three-way battle began. As per Kenobi's command, the Jedi simply disarmed attacking warriors rather than killing them. Skywalker advanced on his attackers, casually disarming them and noting the ease with which he could have finished them. In the end, both clans recognized the futility of attempting to continue the battle, backing down and reluctantly agreeing to make peace. The Jedi returned to the Ansion capital.<ref name="TAS" />

On their way to meet with the political leaders, they were attacked by [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] sent by Soergg the Hutt, who also cut off their communications. Deflecting the initial volley of sniper shots, they took refuge in one of the larger buildings. However, they were accosted within the building and were forced to retreat back to the streets to avoid collateral damage to bystanders. They were ultimately saved only by the intervention of Borokii and Januul warriors. Meeting with the delegation, they managed to convince the politicians against voting for secession.<ref name="TAS" />

====Trailing the assassin====
{{Quote|Next time, try not to lose it.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], upon returning [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] lightsaber|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:AnakinSavesPadme-AOTC1.jpg|thumb|right|225px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] using his lightsaber to kill the two [[Kouhun/Legends|kouhuns]] and save [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempts]] were made on the life of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the former [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]]. As he and Kenobi quietly awaited the killer, they both suddenly [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] danger. Rushing into her bedroom, Skywalker used his lightsaber to bisect two poisonous [[Kouhun/Legends|kouhuns]] about to bite the [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] Senator, while Kenobi leapt out the window, grabbing hold of the [[ASN courier droid/Legends|ASN courier droid]] that had delivered the [[Insect/Legends|insects]]. Skywalker rushed down to the speeder garage and commandeered a [[XJ-6 airspeeder/Legends|XJ-6 airspeeder]], racing after his master.<ref name="AOTC" />

Rescuing Kenobi, Skywalker piloted the [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] after the fleeing [[Zam Wesell/Legends|assassin]]. After a lengthy speeder chase through the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Galactic City/Legends|cityscape]], Skywalker managed to board the assassin's [[Koro-2 all-environment exodrive airspeeder|vehicle]]. Clinging to the exterior, he stabbed his lightsaber into the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], prompting the assassin to fire wildly with her [[KYD-21 blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. She accidentally destroyed the controls, and the vehicle's bucking caused Skywalker to drop his lightsaber. While the assassin's speeder crashed and Skywalker pursued the killer unarmed, his lightsaber spun through the air before being caught by Kenobi. Kenobi intercepted Skywalker at the entrance to the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], returning his lightsaber and scolding him for losing it. The two managed to catch the killer, Kenobi [[Cho sun/Legends|slicing off]] her arm when she attempted to catch him unawares. However, when interrogating her in the alley behind the club, she was killed by an [[Jango Fett/Legends|unknown assailant]], learning only that she had been hired by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="AOTC" />

====Bodyguard and killer====
{{Quote|I... I killed them. I killed them all. They're dead, every single one of them. And not just the men, but the women and the children too. They're like animals, and I ''slaughtered'' them like animals. I ''hate'' them!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], telling [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of the massacre of the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:Anakin_slays_tusken.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] using his lightsaber to slaughter the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].]]
While Kenobi was dispatched to [[Mission to Kamino (Separatist Crisis)/Legends|track down]] the bounty hunter in question, Skywalker was assigned to act as the Senator's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], accompanying her back to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] where they holed up in her [[Varykino/Legends|remote family estate]]. While there, Skywalker was tormented with prophetic [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] regarding his mother's [[Death/Legends|death]]. Leaving for Tatooine with Amidala in tow, he briefly met with his former slave master, [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], learning that he had sold her to a [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farmer]] named [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]], who had since [[Marriage/Legends|married]] her. Meeting with Lars at his [[Lars homestead/Legends|family home]], they learned that Shmi had been abducted during a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] attack. Charging out into the desert on a [[Zephyr-G swoop/Legends|swoop bike]], Skywalker eventually found the [[Unidentified Tusken village/Legends|Tusken camp]]. Quietly approaching, he sliced his way into one of the tents with his lightsaber and found his mother.<ref name="AOTC" />

After Shmi died in his arms, the enraged and distraught Padawan [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|slaughtered]] the hapless Tuskens. Wielding his lightsaber against the warriors, Skywalker surrendered utterly to his rage, massacring the entire Tusken clan, not even sparing the women and children. His actions caused a massive [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]], felt by [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on Coruscant, and left a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] in [[Valley of the Spirits|the area]].<ref name="AOTC" /><ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

After returning to the Lars homestead, Skywalker spent much time consumed by grief and anger, confiding his actions to Senator Amidala. After his mother's [[Funeral of Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|funeral]], they were contacted by Kenobi, who had discovered the identity of the bounty hunter and [[Dogfight over Geonosis/Legends|trailed]] him to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. While there, he discovered that the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]], [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], had hired the bounty hunter, looking to settle a score with Amidala after his defeat and capture by her during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. Gunray was also involved in the Separatist movement, helping contribute to their massive [[Confederacy military/Legends|military]] buildup. Just as he completed his message, he was attacked and captured by a squad of [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]]. Forwarding Kenobi's message to Coruscant, Amidala and Skywalker resolved to go to Geonosis and rescue Kenobi.<ref name="AOTC" />

====Destruction====
{{Quote|Not again! Obi-Wan's gonna kill me.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], upon his lightsaber's destruction|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:SkywalkersLightsaberHalf.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The remaining half of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] lightsaber after its destruction.]]
Infiltrating one of the [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|Geonosis droid foundries]] by way of the worker sleeper cells, they were attacked by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] workers managing the facility. Carving up numerous workers with his lightsaber, Skywalker retreated with Amidala to the assembly lines, where they were split up. Continuing to slice his way through the workers, Skywalker was eventually bested by the machines of the line itself. Initially cutting up most of the mechanical implements, Skywalker was soon knocked over and pinned beneath the machinery. While he managed to free himself, his lightsaber was cut in half by a descending mechanical blade. Skywalker remained oblivious about his ruined weapon until he attempted to activate it, causing it to emit only sparks. Ruefully remarking that Kenobi was going to kill him for allowing this to happen again, Skywalker was captured by droidekas and Jango Fett.<ref name="AOTC" />

===Legacy===
[[File:YetAnotherSuperImportantMetalTube-SBSJ.jpg|left|thumb|Jacen Solo's bore a similar appearance to Anakin's first lightsaber.]]
Skywalker created a lightsaber of similar design to replace it, his [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|second lightsaber]].<ref name="Chapter 1">{{CW|1}}</ref>

After becoming [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, he built a [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|third lightsaber]] based off of this one.

[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], Anakin's grandson, built his [[Jacen Solo's lightsaber|green lightsaber]] that bore a similar appearance to Anakin's first lightsaber.
